what: Completed claim tests whose data contain no organism-level rows of the held-out clade (Aves), so the exam cannot enter them and no result is written. Checked by the holdout thread against each test’s result.json datasets, its analysis.py (no class filter or --exam mode) and the leak check. Verdicts shown are the builders’ own, unexamined.

tests.why_not_applicable: International Chronostratigraphic Chart boundary ages (Macrostrat API): geological time, no organisms
LR04 benthic d18O stack and EPICA Dome C temperature: climate series, no organisms
NHANES body measures: Homo sapiens only (a training organism), no held-out rows possible
Chromosome Counts Database: plants only; the one leak-check hit (Troglodytes) is a plant genus homonym and is allowlisted
Galton 1886 family heights (HistData GaltonFamilies): Homo sapiens only, a training organism; no held-out rows possible
UN World Population Prospects 2024 sex ratio at birth: Homo sapiens country-years only; no held-out rows possible
Nasonia vitripennis (parasitoid wasp) sex-allocation data on Dryad, download blocked (HTTP 403), nothing measured; an insect, outside both candidate clades
Buri 1956 Drosophila melanogaster bw75 allele counts: one insect species, outside both candidate clades
1000 Genomes Phase 3 chromosome 22 and HapMap recombination map: Homo sapiens only, a training organism
Spider contest-display durations on Dryad, download blocked (HTTP 403), nothing measured; an arachnid, outside both candidate clades
ICES DATRAS North Sea bottom-trawl age data: 11 fish species, no birds; fish are training organisms under either candidate clade
Pandita et al. 2013 Turritellidae shell biometrics: 4 gastropod species, 34 specimens; molluscs, outside both candidate clades
Walton and Korn 2018 ammonoid conch ontogeny (Dryad): extinct cephalopods, outside both candidate clades

Figueirido et al. 2021 carnivoran vertebrae and cetacean vertebral counts (Dryad): mammals only, no birds. Note for the clade decision: every organism row in this test is a mammal, so a Mammalia holdout would make the whole test held-out data already seen by its builder
